subject: NorthBridge MAP: environment wiring + POC access sync
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Robinson <alex@carebridge.health>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: NorthBridge MAP: environment wiring + POC access sync

Alex — kicking off the MAP alignment thread for the POC environment wiring. Thanks again for the time on the demo yesterday. To keep the POC runway tight, we want to lock the technical access items this week so our infra team can provision the sandbox and reserved test slots. High-level asks below and a draft MAP attached (MAP_NorthBridge_v1.xlsx).

Key items we need from CareBridge for the POC (target: provision by 2026-11-05):
- Org & tenant: create org level account and add redwood_poc@carebridge.health as a collaborator (we recommend "team-member" role for the POC).
- API keys: a scoped API key for the POC with request-only permissions + rotation window; deliver key via secure shared Drive link or DocuSign/1Password note.
- Network allowlist: CIDR ranges for your dev egress and the preferred NAT IPs for us to add to our allowlist. Please confirm IPv4 blocks and any static IPs we should expect.
- VPC peering: preferred peer region (us-west-2 or us-east-1), and the VPC ID and CIDR for peering. We will propose our peering config once we have your VPC details.

I attached a simple network diagram and the draft MAP. Can you confirm owners and approximate dates for each item? If helpful, we can run a 30-min runbook call Wednesday.

Attachments: MAP_NorthBridge_v1.xlsx (draft MAP), northbridge-network-diagram.png (diagram)

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee 
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.inference.com

From: Alex Robinson <alex@carebridge.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kelly Zhao <kelly.zhao@carebridge.health>, DevOps Team <devops@carebridge.health>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthBridge MAP: environment wiring + POC access sync

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear checklist. We're aligned on the ask. Quick responses below and a couple of questions: 

Owners / ETA (internal):
- Org & tenant: Kelly (IAM) — can add redwood_poc@carebridge.health by Mon 2026-11-01.
- API keys: DevOps — scoped key delivery via 1Password by 2026-11-02.
- Network allowlist: Security will confirm static NAT IPs, expect a finalized list by 2026-10-30 EOD.
- VPC peering: Ops prefers us-east-1. VPC ID will be shared once we confirm route table constraints (target: 2026-11-03).

Questions:
1) For the API key scope — can you confirm whether we should include embedding-only scopes or full generation scope for the POC? We will lock down permissions accordingly.
2) Is there any minimum MTU or subnet sizing we should be aware of on the Redwood side for the peering?

I can join a runbook call Wednesday afternoon; Kelly will be on the thread for the IAM steps.

— Alex
Alex Robinson
Head of Platform Engineering | CareBridge Health
alex@carebridge.health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Robinson <alex@carebridge.health>
Cc: Kelly Zhao <kelly.zhao@carebridge.health>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthBridge MAP: environment wiring + POC access sync

Great — thanks Alex, Kelly. Short answers to your questions and an update to the MAP dates: 

API key scope:
- For fastest iteration, request a key with generation + embeddings scopes but restricted to the POC tenant and a 30-day rotation. That lets us validate the integration surface (both chat and vector searches). If you prefer to be conservative, embeddings-only will work for the initial eval but expect extra prompts from our side to test end-to-end features.

VPC peering details (Redwood notes):
- No special MTU requirements from our side; standard AWS defaults are fine.
- Subnet sizing: we recommend a /20 or larger for the POC peering route table to avoid exhaustion during concurrent test VMs; but we can peer with smaller ranges if needed and just route narrowly.

Revised target provisioning timeline (we'll abide by your owners/ETAs):
- Org & tenant added: 2026-11-01 (Kelly)
- API key delivered to 1Password: 2026-11-02 (DevOps)
- Allowlist finalized: 2026-10-30 EOD (Security)
- VPC peering details shared: 2026-11-03 (Ops)
- Redwood sandbox live: 2026-11-05 (we'll confirm once peering and keys are in place)

Action: Kelly / DevOps to confirm the 1Password note and share the vault path. Alex — can you also share an owner for the peering tickets (who on Ops will be the POC)?

I've also attached our short security questionnaire (security-questionnaire-carebridge.pdf) — if Security can return that along with the allowlist, our security team will do a quick review and sign-off.

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference.com>, Alex Robinson <alex@carebridge.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference.com>, Kelly Zhao <kelly.zhao@carebridge.health>
Date: 2026-10-29T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthBridge MAP: environment wiring + POC access sync

Looping in a quick note from the infra side so CareBridge knows what we'll provision on our end after keys/peering are confirmed: 

What Redwood will stand up for the POC:
- Dedicated sandbox tenant with ephemeral test tokens for the evaluation team.
- A small dedicated pool (1xA10G equivalent) for baseline latency testing; can scale if burst is needed.
- Prefix caching enabled for repeated prompt runs to mirror expected prod behavior.

Evaluation plan highlights we want to validate during the POC (will add detail to the MAP file):
1) Auth: verify scoped API key rejects cross-tenant requests and logs show tenant id mapping.
2) Latency: 95p token latency under 250ms for short chat prompts in us-east-1.
3) Cost: token burn and average token cost report for a representative test set.
4) Features: streaming, function/tool-calling and embedding similarity for retrieval tests.

If CareBridge can provide a short sample prompt set (10-15 representative prompts) and expected throughput, we can pre-configure the test harness and run an initial smoke test within 24 hours of environment spin-up.

— Jordan
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Robinson <alex@carebridge.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kelly Zhao <kelly.zhao@carebridge.health>, DevOps Team <devops@carebridge.health>
Date: 2026-10-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthBridge MAP: environment wiring + POC access sync

Thanks all — short confirmation: 
- Kelly will add the redwood_poc collaborator and share the 1Password vault path by 2026-11-01.
- DevOps will create the scoped API key (generation+embedding) and put in 1Password by 2026-11-02.
- Security to send final allowlist and completed questionnaire (security-questionnaire-carebridge.pdf) by 2026-10-30 EOD.
- Ops owner for peering: Mark Liu (mark.liu@carebridge.health). He will open the AWS peering ticket and share VPC ID by 2026-11-03.

We'll also attach a short sample prompt set and expected throughput doc by tomorrow so you can pre-seed the harness. Looking forward to the runbook call — Wednesday 14:00 PT works for us.

Appreciate the coordination.
— Alex
